title: Non-linear Lie Conformal Algebras and One-Loop Corrections of self-dual Yang-Mills amplitudes
summary: This work is motivated by recent developments in celestial holography. In \cite{CP}, the authors interpreted QCD collinear singularities in terms of operator product expansions in a two-dimensional CFT. We reformulate the algebraic structures arising in their work using the formalism of non-linear Lie conformal algebras developed in \cite{SK}.
